run_mapanything_inference: run MapAnything 3D reconstruction inference on images from a folder using local model weights
run_mapanything_memory_efficient: run MapAnything inference with memory efficient mode to reduce GPU memory usage during reconstruction
run_mapanything_glb_export: run MapAnything inference and export the 3D reconstruction as a GLB file to a specified path
run_mapanything_custom_config: run MapAnything inference with a custom local config JSON string for model initialization parameters
review_main_inference_pipeline: review the main inference pipeline that loads images, runs model inference, and converts depth maps to 3D world points
